context.person: A person using a warehouse picking application
context.user_goal: Choose a one-day delay or cancel the single item.

product_state.preceding_state: A picker found the last unit of an ordered item with damaged packaging.
product_state.current_state: The item has not been packed. No undamaged units remain at this warehouse.
known_facts: The item has not been packed.
No undamaged units remain at this warehouse.
Another warehouse has stock with a one-day delay.
The order can be split or the item can be canceled.
forbidden_claims: Canceling this item cancels the whole order.

current_content.heading: Heads up!
current_content.body: We're working on it. Check again later.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand warehouse pick item damaged, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Request the item from the other warehouse.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The original shipment cannot include an undamaged unit today.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Choose a one-day delay or cancel the single item.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
